Our Experts

My Name is Franklin Ray Pearce. I am a central Florida native and have been doing HVAC work since 1982 after I graduated from high School. I attended the HAVC course at Seminole Community College 1982-1983. From there I was an installer, service technician, service manager and then a State Class B license HVAC contractor and was in business for 24+ years. During that time I also attend a Test and Balance course and was certified for T&B.  I now am the Chief Mechanical Inspector for Orange County Florida and have been with the county for almost 10 years. I also have been teaching HVAC, 2nd year Heatpump course, at Orange Technical College for the past 8 years. I enjoy helping people understand the industry and the changes that are coming. 

Franklin Ray Pearce
15 years Res HVAC

I'm an experienced HVAC professional with over 40 years in the industry, covering manufacturing, R&D, service, technical training, and forensic investigation into indoor air quality and installation issues. I've been part of NATE's mission from the beginning and hold 9 NATE certifications, including Senior Efficiency Analyst. Born in New Mexico, I served as an armored cavalry scout in the Army and later studied HVAC and computer science. My focus is on mastering the science of HVAC system installation and performance evaluations, striving for lab-level accuracy in the field. I'm passionate about sharing my knowledge to inspire and educate future HVAC professionals.

David Small
15 years HVAC Contractor

Paul Welsh is a Florida State Licensed Plumbing Contractor and an esteemed online mentor with 45 years of experience in the Plumbing and Mechanical industry. His expertise includes Gas, Medical Gas, Hydronic, and Chemical Dosing systems. As a Senior Nationwide Plumbing Designer, Paul has contributed to projects in Healthcare, Hospitality, Industrial Plants, Pharmaceuticals, and more. Passionate about training, Paul has mentored countless aspiring plumbers, sharing his extensive knowledge and hands-on learning approach. He believes in the rewarding nature of a plumbing career and continues to shape the industry's future through his dedication to mentorship and professional development.

Paul Welsh
10 years Master Plumber & Contractor
